channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Ross Fire explodes to over 80,000 acres, forces evacuations in North Texas
item.description: The Ross wildfire has burned more than 80,000 acres across Palo Pinto and Jack counties, forcing evacuations, closing roads and disrupting schools.

item.title: Arrest made in fatal shooting of influencer during livestream
item.description: Cesar Gastelum, dressed as a delivery worker, was participating in a social media challenge with two friends when he was fatally shot.

item.title: Iran says Strait of Hormuz deal with Oman shifts responsibility to U.S.
item.description: Amid U.S. economic pressure, Iran promotes a plan with Oman to resume shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, suggesting the next move is Trump's.

item.title: Republicans face midterm test as Iran conflict exceeds Trump's timeline
item.description: The Iran war has significantly influenced the upcoming midterm elections.
